SELECT chat.id, chat.workspace_id, chat.creator_id, chat.agent_id,
  chat.runtime_workspace_id, chat.project_id, chat.title, chat.status, chat.session_id,
  chat.work_dir, chat.session_runtime_id, chat.session_provider, chat.session_execution_fingerprint,
  chat.latest_task_id, chat.pinned, chat.origin_autopilot_id, chat.origin_run_id, chat.created_at, chat.updated_at,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM multiremi_conversation_log m
  LEFT JOIN multiremi_session_lanes legacy ON legacy.session_id = m.session_id
    AND legacy.reader_type = 'member' AND legacy.reader_id = m.to_member_id AND legacy.execution_scope = ''
  LEFT JOIN multiremi_workspace_read_cursors shared ON shared.session_id = m.session_id
    AND shared.workspace_id = chat.workspace_id
  WHERE m.session_id = chat.id AND m.kind = 'message' AND m.visibility = 'shown'
    AND m.to_member_id IS NOT NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND m.seq > COALESCE(legacy.cursor_seq, 0) AND m.seq > COALESCE(shared.cursor_seq, 0)) AS unread_count,
  (SELECT MIN(m.created_at) FROM multiremi_conversation_log m
  LEFT JOIN multiremi_session_lanes legacy ON legacy.session_id = m.session_id
    AND legacy.reader_type = 'member' AND legacy.reader_id = m.to_member_id AND legacy.execution_scope = ''
  LEFT JOIN multiremi_workspace_read_cursors shared ON shared.session_id = m.session_id
    AND shared.workspace_id = chat.workspace_id
  WHERE m.session_id = chat.id AND m.kind = 'message' AND m.visibility = 'shown'
    AND m.to_member_id IS NOT NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND m.seq > COALESCE(legacy.cursor_seq, 0) AND m.seq > COALESCE(shared.cursor_seq, 0)) AS reader_unread_since,
  (SELECT SUBSTR(m.body, 1, 240) FROM multiremi_chat_message_records m WHERE m.chat_session_id = chat.id
    ORDER BY m.sequence DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_content,
  (SELECT m.role FROM multiremi_chat_message_records m WHERE m.chat_session_id = chat.id
    ORDER BY m.sequence DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_role,
  (SELECT m.created_at FROM multiremi_chat_message_records m WHERE m.chat_session_id = chat.id
    ORDER BY m.sequence DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_created_at
  FROM multiremi_chat_sessions chat WHERE chat.id = ?

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS (
    SELECT m.id AS root_id,m.id,m.session_id,m.task_id,m.kind,m.reply_to_id,m.to_agent_id,m.metadata,0 AS depth,1 AS source_inherited
    FROM multiremi_conversation_log m
      JOIN multiremi_conversation_heads h ON h.session_id=m.session_id
      LEFT JOIN multiremi_workspace_read_cursors l ON l.session_id=m.session_id AND l.workspace_id=?
      LEFT JOIN multiremi_session_lanes legacy ON legacy.session_id=m.session_id AND legacy.reader_type='member' AND legacy.reader_id=m.to_member_id AND legacy.execution_scope=''
      LEFT JOIN multiremi_issue_sessions s ON s.id=m.session_id LEFT JOIN multiremi_chat_sessions c ON c.id=COALESCE(s.chat_id,m.session_id)
      LEFT JOIN multiremi_autopilots a ON a.session_id=m.session_id
      WHERE m.to_member_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id)=? AND m.kind='message'
        AND m.seq>COALESCE(l.cursor_seq,0) AND m.seq>COALESCE(legacy.cursor_seq,0) AND m.visibility='shown' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.root_id,n.id,n.session_id,n.task_id,n.kind,n.reply_to_id,n.to_agent_id,n.metadata,d.depth+1,
      CASE WHEN d.source_inherited=1 AND (json_extract(d.metadata,'$.human_response') IS NOT NULL OR json_extract(d.metadata,'$.target_seq') IS NOT NULL OR json_extract(d.metadata,'$.message_id') IS NOT NULL OR CAST(json_extract(d.metadata,'$.question_source_notification') AS TEXT) IN ('true','1')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    FROM ancestors d JOIN multiremi_conversation_log n ON ((n.session_id=d.session_id AND (
    n.id=COALESCE(d.reply_to_id,json_extract(d.metadata,'$.message_id')) OR
    CAST(n.seq AS TEXT)=CAST(json_extract(d.metadata,'$.target_seq') AS TEXT))) OR
    CAST(json_extract(d.metadata,'$.question_source_notification') AS TEXT) IN ('true','1') AND n.id=json_extract(d.metadata,'$.root_question_id'))
    WHERE d.depth<4 AND ((json_extract(d.metadata,'$.human_response') IS NOT NULL OR json_extract(d.metadata,'$.target_seq') IS NOT NULL OR json_extract(d.metadata,'$.message_id') IS NOT NULL OR CAST(json_extract(d.metadata,'$.question_source_notification') AS TEXT) IN ('true','1')) OR d.reply_to_id IS NOT NULL)
  ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS unread_count,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.resolved_at IS NULL AND m.wake_applied<>'inbox_only' AND (
      m.message_kind='decision' OR m.message_kind='request' AND m.sender_type='member'
      OR m.message_kind='status' AND json_extract(m.metadata,'$.lifecycle_event') IN ('task_failed','task_cancelled')
      OR m.message_kind IN ('report','final') AND json_extract(m.metadata,'$.message_outcome') IN ('failed','blocked','cancelled')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS attention_count FROM multiremi_conversation_log m
      JOIN multiremi_conversation_heads h ON h.session_id=m.session_id
      LEFT JOIN multiremi_workspace_read_cursors l ON l.session_id=m.session_id AND l.workspace_id=?
      LEFT JOIN multiremi_session_lanes legacy ON legacy.session_id=m.session_id AND legacy.reader_type='member' AND legacy.reader_id=m.to_member_id AND legacy.execution_scope=''
      LEFT JOIN multiremi_issue_sessions s ON s.id=m.session_id LEFT JOIN multiremi_chat_sessions c ON c.id=COALESCE(s.chat_id,m.session_id)
      LEFT JOIN multiremi_autopilots a ON a.session_id=m.session_id
      WHERE m.to_member_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id)=? AND m.kind='message'
        AND m.seq>COALESCE(l.cursor_seq,0) AND m.seq>COALESCE(legacy.cursor_seq,0) AND m.visibility='shown' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND 1=1 AND ((s.id IS NOT NULL AND s.chat_id IS NULL OR a.id IS NOT NULL OR m.session_id='auto_orphan_inbox_'||COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id))
    OR c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.workspace_id=COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id) AND 1=1) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ancestors d
    LEFT JOIN multiremi_turns t ON t.id=d.task_id OR t.current_attempt_id=d.task_id
    LEFT JOIN multiremi_agents ag ON ag.id=t.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN multiremi_issue_sessions ts ON ts.id=t.session_id
    LEFT JOIN multiremi_chat_sessions sc ON sc.id=COALESCE(ts.chat_id,t.chat_session_id,t.session_id)
    LEFT JOIN multiremi_issue_sessions ds ON ds.id=d.session_id
    LEFT JOIN multiremi_issues di ON di.id=ds.issue_id
    LEFT JOIN multiremi_issues si ON si.id=COALESCE(json_extract(d.metadata,'$.decision_record.source_issue_id'),json_extract(d.metadata,'$.source_issue_id'))
    WHERE d.root_id=m.id AND d.source_inherited=1 AND (
      (d.kind='turn' OR json_extract(d.metadata,'$.human_request') IS NOT NULL
    OR json_extract(d.metadata,'$.human_response') IS NOT NULL AND d.task_id IS NOT NULL) AND (t.id IS NULL OR t.workspace_id<>COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id)
        OR (COALESCE(ts.chat_id,t.chat_session_id) IS NOT NULL OR sc.id IS NOT NULL) AND (sc.id IS NULL OR sc.workspace_id<>COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id) OR NOT (1=1))
        OR COALESCE(ts.chat_id,t.chat_session_id,sc.id) IS NULL AND NOT (1=1))
      OR json_extract(d.metadata,'$.human_response') IS NOT NULL AND d.task_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM multiremi_conversation_log n WHERE ((n.session_id=d.session_id AND (
    n.id=COALESCE(d.reply_to_id,json_extract(d.metadata,'$.message_id')) OR
    CAST(n.seq AS TEXT)=CAST(json_extract(d.metadata,'$.target_seq') AS TEXT))) OR
    CAST(json_extract(d.metadata,'$.question_source_notification') AS TEXT) IN ('true','1') AND n.id=json_extract(d.metadata,'$.root_question_id')))
      OR CAST(json_extract(d.metadata,'$.question_source_notification') AS TEXT) IN ('true','1') AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM multiremi_conversation_log n WHERE n.id=json_extract(d.metadata,'$.root_question_id'))
      OR COALESCE(json_extract(d.metadata,'$.decision_record.source_issue_id'),json_extract(d.metadata,'$.source_issue_id')) IS NOT NULL AND (di.id IS NULL OR si.id IS NULL OR di.workspace_id<>COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id) OR si.workspace_id<>COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id))
      OR d.depth=4 AND (json_extract(d.metadata,'$.human_response') IS NOT NULL OR json_extract(d.metadata,'$.target_seq') IS NOT NULL OR json_extract(d.metadata,'$.message_id') IS NOT NULL OR CAST(json_extract(d.metadata,'$.question_source_notification') AS TEXT) IN ('true','1'))
    )) AND 1=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ancestors notification
    WHERE notification.root_id=m.id AND NOT ((CASE WHEN COALESCE((CAST(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(notification.metadata) THEN notification.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question_notification') AS TEXT) IN ('true','1') OR CAST(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(notification.metadata) THEN notification.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question_present_request') AS TEXT) IN ('true','1')),FALSE) THEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM multiremi_conversation_log q
    JOIN multiremi_conversation_heads qh ON qh.session_id=q.session_id
    LEFT JOIN multiremi_workspace_members human ON json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.source_issue_id') IS NULL AND human.id=json_extract((CASE WHEN json_valid(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route')) THEN json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route') ELSE '[]' END),'$[#-1].handler.id')
      AND human.workspace_id=COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id) AND human.archived_at IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN multiremi_issues source ON source.id=json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.source_issue_id')
    WHERE q.id=json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(notification.metadata) THEN notification.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.root_question_id') AND q.kind='message' AND q.visibility='shown' AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND CAST(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.version') AS TEXT)='1'
      AND json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.workspace_id')=COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id) AND qh.workspace_id=COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id)
      AND (json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.source_issue_id') IS NULL OR source.workspace_id=COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id))
      AND json_extract((CASE WHEN json_valid(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route')) THEN json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route') ELSE '[]' END),'$[#-1].stage')='human' AND (json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.source_issue_id') IS NOT NULL OR json_extract((CASE WHEN json_valid(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route')) THEN json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route') ELSE '[]' END),'$[#-1].handler.type')='member' AND human.id IS NOT NULL)
      AND CAST(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route_revision') AS TEXT)=CAST(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(notification.metadata) THEN notification.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question_route_revision') AS TEXT)
      AND 1=1) ELSE TRUE END)))

      AND CAST(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.version') AS TEXT)='1'
      AND json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.workspace_id')=COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id) AND qh.workspace_id=COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id)
      AND (json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.source_issue_id') IS NULL OR source.workspace_id=COALESCE(s.workspace_id,c.workspace_id,a.workspace_id,h.workspace_id))
      AND json_extract((CASE WHEN json_valid(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route')) THEN json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route') ELSE '[]' END),'$[#-1].stage')='human' AND (json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.source_issue_id') IS NOT NULL OR json_extract((CASE WHEN json_valid(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route')) THEN json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route') ELSE '[]' END),'$[#-1].handler.type')='member' AND human.id IS NOT NULL)
      AND CAST(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(q.metadata) THEN q.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question.route_revision') AS TEXT)=CAST(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(notification.metadata) THEN notification.metadata ELSE '{}' END,'$.question_route_revision') AS TEXT)
      AND 1=1) ELSE TRUE END))) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.id DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT chat.id, chat.workspace_id, chat.creator_id, chat.agent_id,
  chat.runtime_workspace_id, chat.project_id, chat.title, chat.status, chat.session_id,
  chat.work_dir, chat.session_runtime_id, chat.session_provider, chat.session_execution_fingerprint,
  chat.latest_task_id, chat.pinned, chat.origin_autopilot_id, chat.origin_run_id, chat.created_at, chat.updated_at,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM multiremi_conversation_log m
  LEFT JOIN multiremi_session_lanes legacy ON legacy.session_id = m.session_id
    AND legacy.reader_type = 'member' AND legacy.reader_id = m.to_member_id AND legacy.execution_scope = ''
  LEFT JOIN multiremi_workspace_read_cursors shared ON shared.session_id = m.session_id
    AND shared.workspace_id = chat.workspace_id
  WHERE m.session_id = chat.id AND m.kind = 'message' AND m.visibility = 'shown'
    AND m.to_member_id IS NOT NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND m.seq > COALESCE(legacy.cursor_seq, 0) AND m.seq > COALESCE(shared.cursor_seq, 0)) AS unread_count,
  (SELECT MIN(m.created_at) FROM multiremi_conversation_log m
  LEFT JOIN multiremi_session_lanes legacy ON legacy.session_id = m.session_id
    AND legacy.reader_type = 'member' AND legacy.reader_id = m.to_member_id AND legacy.execution_scope = ''
  LEFT JOIN multiremi_workspace_read_cursors shared ON shared.session_id = m.session_id
    AND shared.workspace_id = chat.workspace_id
  WHERE m.session_id = chat.id AND m.kind = 'message' AND m.visibility = 'shown'
    AND m.to_member_id IS NOT NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND m.seq > COALESCE(legacy.cursor_seq, 0) AND m.seq > COALESCE(shared.cursor_seq, 0)) AS reader_unread_since,
  (SELECT SUBSTR(m.body, 1, 240) FROM multiremi_chat_message_records m WHERE m.chat_session_id = chat.id
    ORDER BY m.sequence DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_content,
  (SELECT m.role FROM multiremi_chat_message_records m WHERE m.chat_session_id = chat.id
    ORDER BY m.sequence DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_role,
  (SELECT m.created_at FROM multiremi_chat_message_records m WHERE m.chat_session_id = chat.id
    ORDER BY m.sequence DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_created_at
  FROM multiremi_chat_sessions chat WHERE workspace_id = ? AND origin_autopilot_id IS NULL AND status != 'archived' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM multiremi_feishu_bot_chat_bindings binding
        WHERE binding.chat_session_id = chat.id) ORDER BY pinned DESC, updated_at DESC

SELECT runtime.*, profile.display_name AS daemon_display_name,
              upgrade.status AS protocol_upgrade_status, upgrade.error AS protocol_upgrade_error
       FROM multiremi_runtimes runtime
       LEFT JOIN multiremi_daemon_profiles profile
         ON profile.workspace_id = COALESCE(runtime.workspace_id, 'local')
        AND profile.daemon_id = runtime.daemon_id
       LEFT JOIN (
         SELECT runtime_id, status, error,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY runtime_id
                  ORDER BY CASE WHEN status IN ('pending', 'running', 'restarting', 'verifying') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                           created_at DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC) AS update_rank
         FROM multiremi_runtime_update_requests
         WHERE scope = 'cli' AND runtime_id IN (
           SELECT id FROM multiremi_runtimes WHERE COALESCE(workspace_id, 'local') = ?
         )
       ) upgrade ON upgrade.runtime_id = runtime.id AND upgrade.update_rank = 1
       WHERE COALESCE(runtime.workspace_id, 'local') = ?
       ORDER BY runtime.updated_at DESC, runtime.id DESC

WITH selected AS (SELECT id FROM multiremi_runtimes WHERE COALESCE(workspace_id, 'local') = ?), owners AS (
      SELECT t.runtime_id,t.turn_id AS task_id FROM multiremi_turn_execution_records t WHERE t.runtime_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected)
      UNION SELECT u.runtime_id,t.turn_id AS task_id FROM multiremi_usage_units u JOIN multiremi_turn_execution_records t ON t.id=u.task_id WHERE u.runtime_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected)
    ), counts AS (SELECT runtime_id,COUNT(*) AS task_count FROM owners GROUP BY runtime_id), lifecycle AS (
      SELECT runtime_id,SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (?,?,?,?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_task_count,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status='completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_task_count,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status='failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_task_count
      FROM multiremi_turn_execution_records t WHERE t.id=(SELECT current_attempt_id FROM multiremi_turns WHERE id=t.turn_id) AND runtime_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected) GROUP BY runtime_id
    ), tokens AS (SELECT u.runtime_id,SUM(COALESCE(u.input_tokens,0)) AS input_tokens,SUM(COALESCE(u.output_tokens,0)) AS output_tokens,
      SUM(COALESCE(u.cache_read_tokens,0)) AS cache_read_tokens,SUM(COALESCE(u.cache_write_tokens,0)) AS cache_write_tokens
      FROM multiremi_usage_units u JOIN multiremi_turn_execution_records t ON t.id=u.task_id WHERE u.runtime_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected) GROUP BY u.runtime_id)
    SELECT selected.id,counts.task_count,lifecycle.active_task_count,lifecycle.completed_task_count,lifecycle.failed_task_count,
      tokens.input_tokens,tokens.output_tokens,tokens.cache_read_tokens,tokens.cache_write_tokens
    FROM selected LEFT JOIN counts ON counts.runtime_id=selected.id LEFT JOIN lifecycle ON lifecycle.runtime_id=selected.id
    LEFT JOIN tokens ON tokens.runtime_id=selected.id
